Worlds with ores 1.3.0 for Minecraft Forge 1.20.1

SUMMARY
- Portal worlds, soft industrial multi-ore terrain, Lava Obsidian tools/armor
- Portal Flux energy is WORK IN PROGRESS (playable prototype with 8 modules)

CHANGES IN 1.3.0
- Industrial dims: weighted multi-ore soft fill (all ores per mod, primary-dominant)
- Requires-mod tooltips on industrial igniters
- 8 reactor module slots + Heat Cap / Overclock / Transfer / Safeguard
- Energy port transfer FE/t readout; stronger transfer module push
- Portal Chest Sort + Deposit matching + comparator
- Book / lang EN+RU updates (Extreme Reactors wording)

CURSEFORGE UPLOAD
1. Upload: dist/curseforge/worlds_with_ores-1.3.0-1.20.1.jar
2. Game versions: Forge 1.20.1
3. Release type: Beta (energy WIP)
4. Paste CHANGELOG_CF.txt into the changelog field
